fields.statement: QA by hand with the built binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza at 952263bc7) in a fresh scratch repo (git init, rhiza init, change new, rhiza daemon set rhiza.ship.localGate to a script, a ci-stability.json with an identified flake so CI is unstable). Failing gate printing '--- FAIL: TestEarly' and 'FAIL example.com/pkg/early' first, 30000 filler lines (619039 bytes), then make's 'Error 1', exit 2: rhiza ship gate exited 1; its last 20 human lines (a step's kept tail) held '--- FAIL: TestEarly', the FAIL line, 'Full log: <common>/rhiza/gate/cs/qa-gate-log.log' and the failure line; --json log names that file, output kept at the 16 KB tail; the log file is byte-identical to the gate's full output (cmp). A passing gate (echo all fine) exited 0 and replaced the log with 'all fine'; rerun on the same gated head passes from the cache without rerunning or naming a log. grep -c 'run `rhiza ship gate` to see' prints 0 for ship-change.toml and docs.toml; both gate-fix prompts in each name `rhiza run status --json` and the full gate log file. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipGateFullLog|TestShipRebase|TestShipLocalGate' and ./cmd/rhiza TestScripts/(describe-golden|ship-local-gate) pass. Rebase-path log write checked through its unit test only.
